primary.title: Big action! Who is Avadhut Sathe? Why SEBI ordered Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy to refund ₹546 cr - What he did?
primary.summary: SEBI ordered Avadhut Sathe and his trading academy to refund ₹546.17 crore, plus ₹67.87 crore in interest, for providing unregistered investment advice and research services. The regulator also imposed ₹11.5 crore in penalties and directed refunds within five months.
